svg.title: AREA 31
svg.desc: One player may collect the waterfall boxes while the party advances; assign the collector to suit the team. Run past these Foie turrets along the route; no need to stop and destroy them. Detour to heal only if needed; the Force can refill TP while others approach the puzzle. Three wait at the puzzle while one goes deep south for the pad; ignore enemies and return after activating it. South orange opens entry. Hold green to send one through upper-right 1. That player holds blue, releasing the others to lower-left 2. Watch two turrets. Regroup via 3, then coordinate two players at the door. Boxes behind nearby rocks are optional. Ignore warp 4 in the last room and leave through the south exit.
